messages:
devon: quick heads-up — running the python sampleapp batching helper: /v1/embeddings -> /v1/rerank is producing a 400 because some vectors are 1536 and the model expects 1024.
abby: which sdk/version and model id? can you paste the exact error and a trimmed payload?
devon: python sampleapp 0.3.2, model: openembed-1024. payload (trimmed):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ 
  "model": "openembed-1024",
  "input": ["doc1", "doc2", "doc3"]
}
```
error: `400 Bad Request: embedding dimension 1536 != model dimension 1024`
kevin: 1536 looks like the node packaged model we ship. Could be a cache collision (old node cache + new python client). do we merge cached vectors?
devon: yes — the helper merges cached vectors (local disk) with freshly computed batch vectors before calling rerank. I dumped the merged array and one entry had length 1536.
abby: ah — sdk parity issue then. node writes key `vectors` and uses openembed-1536, python expects `embedding` and openembed-1024. we should validate on load.
nina: also saw another angle: if the auth token expires mid-batch, retry logic replays the batch but doesn't refresh Authorization header, so first retry gets 401 and then downstream operations see mixed shapes because partial retries interleave. example log: 
```
HTTP 401 Token expired
retrying batch (attempt 2)
HTTP 400 {"error":"embedding dimension 1536 != model dimension 1024"}
```
kevin: so two bugs: 1) cache/dim validation + key normalization, 2) retry should refresh token before replaying.
abby: agree. smaller fix: when loading cached vectors drop any item whose length != expected_dim and log a warning with the key. also add a migration snippet for `vectors` -> `embedding`.
devon: will open a PR on sampleapp to: (a) validate cached dims and drop bad entries, (b) normalize fields to `embedding` on load, (c) update retry to call auth.refresh_token() before replay.
kevin: add unit tests: write a fake cache entry with 1536 dims -> ensure loader drops it; and simulate auth expiry in integration test to confirm token is refreshed on retry.
abby: i'll write the test harness and a short CLI repro for QA. minimal curl to reproduce initial 400 (for test doc):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <EXPIRED_OR_MIXED_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"openembed-1024","input":["a","b","c"]}'
```
then run rerank with a cache file containing one 1536-length vector.
nina: can we add a short note to the SDK parity doc about the `vectors` vs `embedding` key and include a tiny migration snippet for node->python? saves future confusion.
devon: yes, will add to docs and link in PR.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: sampleapp/patch-validate-cache -> staging
kevin: after deploy, run devex/regress-embed-parity job against historical caches.
abby: i'll post results here once the job finishes. :thumbsup:
